input.summary: All 35 controls now have a proposal or a question on record. Movement (arrows, dpad, left stick), jump/dash/grab/pause on both keyboard and controller (kb_c, kb_x, kb_left_shift, kb_escape, Y, X, B, start) were bound from clear leading patterns for those exact keys/buttons in their history — evidenced. The four redundant grab channels (left_trigger, right_trigger, left_bumper, right_bumper) and the dpad/left-stick movement duplicates were inferred by carrying over the evidenced binding for the identical job from the keyboard equivalent, since those outputs have no history of their own. kb_z was asked about rather than settled, since its own history splits between quick-tap options that don't fit the hold-style job the way kb_left_shift's leader does. The 12 remaining controls (back, quick_restart_controller, kb_a, kb_e, kb_f, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_control, kb_q, kb_s, kb_w, mouse_right_button) have no identified function in Celeste per the sourced control list; rather than silently leaving them unbound or guessing a job for them, each was turned into a question offering their own leading historical choice for that exact input alongside the option to leave it unbound. Nothing was changed or bound without either direct evidence for that exact control/job, a clearly-labeled inference from the same job elsewhere in this game, or the person's own answer to a direct question.
